description:
Approve or reject a revision of a schema proposal, with an optional comment, the same action as Review in GraphOS Studio.
Only a requested reviewer can review, and calling this again replaces the caller's earlier review.
Returns the proposal's status and its reviews, or an error with a message.
Provide the graph ID, the proposal variant name and latestRevision.id from GetProposal, and the decision (APPROVED or NOT_APPROVED).
name: ReviewProposal
